# Kex documentation

Everything published at https://docs.kex.run, one section per documented unit.
Sections list alphabetically, which reads as a curriculum: the Guide
first, then the Standard Library, then Tey.

How to read this with an LLM: start with the Guide, then the prelude
tour, then the reference sections. A section marked (latest) is the
release to cite; versions ending in `-dev` are unreleased snapshots.
`versions.json` enumerates every published (package, version), and each
one carries its own `model.json` and `search.json`. Every page below
also exists as raw Markdown — the same address with `.html` swapped
for `.md` — and the whole corpus concatenated is `llms-full.txt`.
## Guide 0.4.0-alpha-dev

- [Overview](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha-dev/overview.html)
- [Syntax](https://docs.kex.run/guide/0.4.0-alpha-dev/syntax.html)
